projects.name: Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
An analytics dashboard that ingests customer CSV files, analyzes application logs, and presents interactive visualizations. Scope covers data ingestion and processing, log parsing and analysis, a visualization layer, and end-to-end integration, testing, and release.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-processing, log-analysis, visualization

tasks.name: M1 — Project Foundation & Data Contracts
tasks.details: Milestone: establish scope, architecture, and the shared data contracts that CSV processing, log analysis, and visualizations all depend on. Exit criteria: approved architecture, documented CSV and log schemas, and a runnable project skeleton.

tasks.name: M2 — Customer CSV Ingestion & Processing
tasks.details: Milestone: reliably ingest customer CSV files, validate and clean records, and produce a normalized customer dataset available to the analytics layer. Exit criteria: batch ingestion works end to end with validation reports and rejected-row handling.

tasks.name: M3 — Application Log Analysis
tasks.details: Milestone: parse application logs into structured events, compute usage/error metrics, and expose the aggregates the dashboard needs. Exit criteria: log ingestion, parsing rules, and metric rollups verified against sample logs.

tasks.name: M4 — Data Storage & API Layer
tasks.details: Milestone: persist processed customer and log data and serve it through a documented API consumed by the dashboard. Exit criteria: schema migrations applied, endpoints implemented and contract-tested.

tasks.name: M5 — Visualization Components & Dashboard UI
tasks.details: Milestone: build reusable chart components and assemble the dashboard pages that present customer and log insights. Exit criteria: all agreed widgets render real data, are responsive, and meet accessibility basics.

tasks.name: M6 — Integration, Testing & Release
tasks.details: Milestone: connect all pipelines to the UI, verify end-to-end behavior with realistic data volumes, and ship the first release. Exit criteria: passing test suite, performance check, deployment runbook, and production release.

tasks.name: Define scope, KPIs, and dashboard requirements
tasks.details: Capture stakeholder goals, the questions the dashboard must answer, and success KPIs. Produce a concise requirements doc listing customer metrics, log/reliability metrics, and agreed v1 scope boundaries.

tasks.name: Choose tech stack and draft architecture
tasks.details: Select language, storage, API framework, and visualization library. Produce a one-page architecture diagram covering ingestion, processing, storage, API, and UI, plus key trade-off notes.

tasks.name: Define customer CSV schema and quality rules
tasks.details: Document required/optional columns, data types, accepted formats (dates, currency, country codes), uniqueness constraints, and validation rules. Deliver a machine-readable schema plus a short data-quality rule list.

tasks.name: Define log schema and parsing contract
tasks.details: Inventory current application log formats, define the normalized event schema (timestamp, level, service, message, request id, user id, latency), and document parsing rules and unknown-format fallback behavior.

tasks.name: Scaffold repository, CI, and environments
tasks.details: Create the repo layout, base dependencies, lint/format config, unit test runner, CI pipeline, and local dev environment instructions. Include sample data directories and secret handling conventions.

tasks.name: Build CSV intake (upload endpoint or CLI)
tasks.details: Implement the entry point that receives customer CSV files, enforces size/type limits, stores the raw file, and records an ingestion job with status. Keep transport concerns separate from parsing logic.

tasks.name: Implement CSV parsing and schema validation
tasks.details: Stream-parse CSV files, map headers to the agreed schema, validate types and required fields, and collect per-row validation errors without aborting the whole batch. Handle quoted fields, delimiters, and encoding issues.

tasks.name: Clean and normalize customer records
tasks.details: Trim whitespace, standardize date and currency formats, normalize country/region values, deduplicate customers by stable key, and merge conflicting duplicates using documented precedence rules.

tasks.name: Rejected-row reporting and ingestion error handling
tasks.details: Produce a downloadable rejected-rows report with row number and reason, summarize counts per validation rule, make jobs idempotent, and add retry behavior for transient failures.

tasks.name: Load normalized customers into storage
tasks.details: Upsert cleaned customer records into the target store in batches, track load statistics, and ensure re-runs do not create duplicates. Keep the load step reusable by scheduled batch runs.

tasks.name: CSV pipeline tests with fixture files
tasks.details: Create fixture CSVs covering valid rows, malformed rows, duplicate customers, odd encodings, and large batches. Write unit and integration tests for parsing, validation, cleaning, and loading.

tasks.name: Inventory log sources and collect samples
tasks.details: Identify every application log source (services, file paths, rotation policy, formats), collect representative samples including edge cases (stack traces, multi-line events, unicode), and note retention and volume characteristics.

tasks.name: Build log ingestion (batch import and incremental tail)
tasks.details: Implement log file discovery and reading with checkpointing so incremental runs resume without duplicating events. Handle rotated and compressed files, and record ingestion job status and counts.

tasks.name: Implement log parsing rules per format
tasks.details: Write parsers for each discovered format (e.g., JSON lines, common log format, framework text logs), map fields to the normalized event schema, join multi-line stack traces, and fall back safely on unknown lines.

tasks.name: Compute log analytics metrics and rollups
tasks.details: Aggregate normalized events into hourly/daily metrics: request volume, error rate by service, p50/p95 latency, active users, and top error signatures. Store rollups for fast dashboard queries.

tasks.name: Validate log pipeline against sample logs
tasks.details: Build fixture log files and assertion tests for parsing accuracy, checkpoint resume, malformed-line handling, and metric correctness. Compare rollups against hand-computed expected values.

tasks.name: Design data model and write schema migrations
tasks.details: Model customer, ingestion-job, log-event, and metric-rollup tables in the chosen store. Write versioned migrations with rollback support and seed a small sample dataset for development.

tasks.name: Implement customer analytics API endpoints
tasks.details: Expose read endpoints for customer counts, growth over time, segment breakdowns, and ingestion-job status. Support pagination and consistent error responses.

tasks.name: Implement log metrics API endpoints
tasks.details: Expose read endpoints for traffic volume, error rate by service, latency percentiles, active users, and top error signatures, with date-range and service filters.

tasks.name: Document API and add contract tests
tasks.details: Generate an OpenAPI-style spec or equivalent docs, add example requests/responses, and write contract tests that fail if response shapes drift from the documented schema.

tasks.name: Add caching and query performance tuning
tasks.details: Add indexes for common filters, cache expensive rollup queries with sensible invalidation, and document expected response times for each endpoint under representative data volumes.

tasks.name: Build dashboard layout shell and navigation
tasks.details: Create the app shell: header, sidebar navigation, page routing, loading and error states, and a consistent card/grid layout that hosts all widgets.

tasks.name: Build reusable chart component library
tasks.details: Implement shared wrappers for line, bar, stacked-area, sparkline, and data-table widgets, each with loading/empty/error states, tooltips, legends, and a consistent data prop contract.

tasks.name: Assemble customer analytics page
tasks.details: Compose KPI tiles, growth trend, segment breakdown, and recent-ingestion table into a customer analytics page wired to the customer endpoints.

tasks.name: Assemble log and reliability page
tasks.details: Compose traffic volume, error-rate by service, latency percentile, active-user, and top-errors widgets into a log analytics page wired to the metrics endpoints.

tasks.name: Add global filters and date-range state
tasks.details: Implement a shared filter bar (date range presets, service selector, customer segment) with URL-persisted state so links are shareable and pages reload consistently.

tasks.name: Responsive design and accessibility pass
tasks.details: Verify layouts at mobile/tablet/desktop widths, add keyboard navigation and focus states, ensure chart color contrast and text alternatives, and fix findings from a quick audit.

tasks.name: Wire end-to-end data flow
tasks.details: Connect CSV and log pipelines to storage and APIs, connect the UI to the APIs, and verify a single run flows from raw files to rendered dashboard widgets without manual steps.

tasks.name: Complete automated test suite
tasks.details: Fill unit-test gaps, add integration tests for pipelines and APIs, and add a small E2E suite covering the two main dashboard pages and filter behavior. Wire everything into CI.

tasks.name: Performance and load validation
tasks.details: Generate realistic CSV and log volumes, measure ingestion throughput and API response times, confirm dashboard load times are acceptable, and record bottlenecks with follow-up actions.

tasks.name: Security and customer data privacy review
tasks.details: Check access control, secret management, PII handling and masking in sample data, log redaction, and dependency vulnerabilities. Document findings and fix any release blockers.

tasks.name: Prepare deployment pipeline and runbook
tasks.details: Define environment configuration, database migration steps, scheduled ingestion jobs, rollback procedure, monitoring/alerts, and a concise operations runbook.

tasks.name: Run UAT and ship v1 release
tasks.details: Walk stakeholders through the dashboard, collect sign-off against the requirements doc, resolve critical feedback, tag the release, and publish release notes.
